name: prisma
description: Installed Prisma language-server 31.11.0 requests workspace/configuration section "prisma" and reads settings.enableDiagnostics. Set settings to {"prisma":{"enableDiagnostics":true}}; the built-in client must answer that section with {"enableDiagnostics":true}. initialize options can be empty. Do not invent validate.enable; do not change .prisma source to configure validation. This installed version dereferences a null section and crashes, so explicitly provide the prisma object. Version compatibility: this installed @prisma/language-server uses Prisma 7 schema rules, including rejecting datasource.url in schema.prisma. Prisma 6 accepts that field. Check the project Prisma CLI/client major version before trusting schema diagnostics. Installing a project Prisma CLI does not switch this preset server to that version. For an existing Prisma 6 project, install a compatible @prisma/language-server release and start its executable with --command <project-local-prisma-language-server> --args '["--stdio"]'. Keep the project schema compatible with its actual runtime; do not migrate a valid application schema merely to satisfy an incompatible diagnostic server. Compare a corrected schema with the project-local prisma validate command. See https://www.prisma.io/docs/orm/v7/reference/prisma-config-reference for Prisma 7 configuration.
